add.k: Flint Marko's gravely ill young daughter
st: Penny tells her escaped father Flint she missed him too and gives him her pendant, and he vows to get the money to heal her.

files.notes: Credited name confirmed on Wikipedia (Perla Haney-Jardine plays his daughter Penny). The pendant comes from the Marvel Movies wiki page; the line and his promise are in the transcript. Only mentioned in Spider-Man: No Way Home, so no step there.

add.k: A store clerk who refuses Peter his milk
st: T-Bone mocks Peter and refuses him his milk over two cents, then a thief robs his register and Peter will not help stop him.

files.notes: Credited name confirmed on Wikipedia (Michael Barra plays T-Bone, the store clerk). The store's name (Forest Hills Market on the Marvel Movies wiki) is not confirmed as said or shown on screen, so tm is Independent.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Emma confronts her escaped husband Flint at their apartment and calls him a common thief who may even have killed a man. She orders him away from their sick daughter Penny as the police close in.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Emma raises her sick daughter Penny alone while Flint is in prison. When Flint comes home, Emma tries to keep him away from Penny.

stages.title: Spider-Man 3
stages.text: Flint sneaks home from prison to see Penny, who tells him she missed him too and gives him her pendant. He promises to make her healthy again, and later tells Peter that his daughter is all he has left.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
stages.text: Miss Calleros teaches Miles's class that ours is one of many parallel universes. When he scores a zero on a true or false quiz, she tells him only someone who knows the right answers can get them all wrong, refuses to let him quit and assigns an essay about who he wants to be. Miles finishes that essay after becoming Spider-Man.
stages.whoA: Miles, a new student in her class

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: Store clerk T-Bone refuses to sell Peter his milk when he is two cents short, and mocks him for it. When a thief robs the register, T-Bone asks Peter for a little help, and Peter answers that it is not his policy.
stages.whoA: Peter, a customer two cents short
stages.whoB: T-Bone, the clerk who mocks him

stages.title: The Amazing Spider-Man
stages.text: A man in line behind Peter distracts T-Bone and robs his open cash register. T-Bone shouts for someone to stop him as the thief escapes.
stages.whoA: The thief who robs his register
